verses.arabic: حمٓ
verses.english: Ha, Meem.
verses.transliteration_html: <u>Ha</u>meem
verses.transliteration_text: Hameem

verses.arabic: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.english: By the Manifest Book:
verses.transliteration_html: Waalkitabi almubeeni
verses.transliteration_text: Waalkitabi almubeeni

verses.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.english: We have made it an Arabic Quran so that you may exercise your reason,
verses.transliteration_html: Inn<u>a</u> jaAAaln<u>a</u>hu qur<u>a</u>nan AAarabiyyan laAAallakum taAAqiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Inna jaAAalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan laAAallakum taAAqiloona

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
verses.english: and it is sublime and wise with Us in the Mother Book.
verses.transliteration_html: Wainnahu fee ommi alkitabi ladayna laAAaliyyun hakeemun
verses.transliteration_text: Wainnahu fee ommi alkitabi ladayna laAAaliyyun hakeemun

verses.arabic: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا مُّسْرِفِينَ
verses.english: Shall We keep back the Reminder from you and disregard you because you are an unrestrained lot?
verses.transliteration_html: Afanadribu AAankumu alththikra safhan an kuntum qawman musrifeena
verses.transliteration_text: Afanadribu AAankumu alththikra safhan an kuntum qawman musrifeena

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّۢ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.english: How many a prophet We have sent to the former peoples!
verses.transliteration_html: Wakam arsalna min nabiyyin fee alawwaleena
verses.transliteration_text: Wakam arsalna min nabiyyin fee alawwaleena

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.english: There did not come to them any prophet but that they used to deride him.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama yateehim min nabiyyin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona
verses.transliteration_text: Wama yateehim min nabiyyin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona

verses.arabic: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.english: So We destroyed those who were stronger than these, and the example of the former peoples has already come to pass.
verses.transliteration_html: Faahlakna ashadda minhum batshan wamada mathalu alawwaleena
verses.transliteration_text: Faahlakna ashadda minhum batshan wamada mathalu alawwaleena

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.english: If you ask them, ‘Who created the heavens and the earth?’ they will surely say, ‘The All-mighty, the All-knowing created them.’
verses.transliteration_html: Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna khalaqahunna alAAazeezu alAAaleemu
verses.transliteration_text: Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna khalaqahunna alAAazeezu alAAaleemu

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
verses.english: He, who made the earth a cradle for you, and made for you in it ways so that you may be guided [to your destinations],
verses.transliteration_html: Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wajaAAala lakum feeha subulan laAAallakum tahtadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wajaAAala lakum feeha subulan laAAallakum tahtadoona

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
verses.english: and who sent down water from the sky in a measured manner, and We revived with it a dead country. Likewise, you shall be raised [from the dead].
verses.transliteration_html: Waallathee nazzala mina alssamai maan biqadarin faansharna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika tukhrajoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waallathee nazzala mina alssamai maan biqadarin faansharna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika tukhrajoona

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ
verses.english: He created all the kinds and made for you the ships and the cattle such which you ride,
verses.transliteration_html: Waallathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha wajaAAala lakum mina alfulki waalanAAami ma tarkaboona
verses.transliteration_text: Waallathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha wajaAAala lakum mina alfulki waalanAAami ma tarkaboona

verses.arabic: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
verses.english: that you may sit on their backs, then remember the blessing of your Lord when you are settled on them, and say, ‘Immaculate is He who has disposed this for us, and we [by ourselves] were no match for it.
verses.transliteration_html: Litastawoo AAala thuhoorihi thumma tathkuroo niAAmata rabbikum itha istawaytum AAalayhi wataqooloo subhana allathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineena
verses.transliteration_text: Litastawoo AAala thuhoorihi thumma tathkuroo niAAmata rabbikum itha istawaytum AAalayhi wataqooloo subhana allathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
verses.english: Indeed we shall return to our Lord.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboona
verses.transliteration_text: Wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboona

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
verses.english: They ascribe to Him offspring from among His servants! Man is indeed a manifest ingrate.
verses.transliteration_html: WajaAAaloo lahu min AAibadihi juzan inna alinsana lakafoorun mubeenun
verses.transliteration_text: WajaAAaloo lahu min AAibadihi juzan inna alinsana lakafoorun mubeenun

verses.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍۢ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ
verses.english: Did He adopt daughters from what He creates while He preferred you with sons?
verses.transliteration_html: Ami ittakhatha mimma yakhluqu banatin waasfakum bialbaneena
verses.transliteration_text: Ami ittakhatha mimma yakhluqu banatin waasfakum bialbaneena

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مَثَلًۭا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّۭا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
verses.english: When one of them is brought the news of what he ascribes to the All-beneficent, his face becomes darkened and he chokes with suppressed rage, [and says]
verses.transliteration_html: Waitha bushshira ahaduhum bima daraba lilrrahmani mathalan thalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa katheemun
verses.transliteration_text: Waitha bushshira ahaduhum bima daraba lilrrahmani mathalan thalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa katheemun

verses.arabic: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍۢ
verses.english: ‘What! One who is brought up amid ornaments and is inconspicuous in contests?’
verses.transliteration_html: Awaman yunashshao fee alhilyati wahuwa fee alkhisami ghayru mubeenin
verses.transliteration_text: Awaman yunashshao fee alhilyati wahuwa fee alkhisami ghayru mubeenin

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَـٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ إِنَـٰثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَـٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ
verses.english: They have made the angels—who are servants of the All-beneficent—females. Were they witness to their creation? Their testimony will be written down and they shall be questioned.
verses.transliteration_html: WajaAAaloo almalaikata allatheena hum AAibadu alrrahmani inathan ashahidoo khalqahum satuktabu shahadatuhum wayusaloona
verses.transliteration_text: WajaAAaloo almalaikata allatheena hum AAibadu alrrahmani inathan ashahidoo khalqahum satuktabu shahadatuhum wayusaloona

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَـٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
verses.english: They say, ‘Had the All-beneficent wished, we would not have worshipped them.’ They do not have any knowledge of that, and they do nothing but surmise.
verses.transliteration_html: Waqaloo law shaa alrrahmanu ma AAabadnahum ma lahum bithalika min AAilmin in hum illa yakhrusoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waqaloo law shaa alrrahmanu ma AAabadnahum ma lahum bithalika min AAilmin in hum illa yakhrusoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ كِتَـٰبًۭا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ
verses.english: Did We give them a Book before this, so that they are holding fast to it?
verses.transliteration_html: Am ataynahum kitaban min qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikoona
verses.transliteration_text: Am ataynahum kitaban min qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikoona

verses.arabic: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verses.english: No, they said, ‘We found our fathers following a creed, and we are indeed guided in their footsteps.’
verses.transliteration_html: Bal qaloo inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muhtadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Bal qaloo inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muhtadoona

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍۢ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
verses.english: So it has been that We did not send any warner to a town before you, without its affluent ones saying, ‘We found our fathers following a creed and we are indeed following in their footsteps.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wakathalika ma arsalna min qablika fee qaryatin min natheerin illa qala mutrafooha inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muqtadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wakathalika ma arsalna min qablika fee qaryatin min natheerin illa qala mutrafooha inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muqtadoona

verses.arabic: ۞ قَـٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.english: He would say, ‘What! Even if I bring you a better guidance than what you found your fathers following?!’ They would say, ‘We indeed disbelieve in what you are sent with.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala awalaw jitukum biahda mimma wajadtum AAalayhi abaakum qaloo inna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Qala awalaw jitukum biahda mimma wajadtum AAalayhi abaakum qaloo inna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroona

verses.arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.english: Thereupon We took vengeance on them; so observe how was the fate of the deniers.
verses.transliteration_html: Faintaqamna minhum faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeena
verses.transliteration_text: Faintaqamna minhum faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeena

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.english: When Abraham said to his father and his people, ‘I repudiate what you worship,
verses.transliteration_html: Waith qala ibraheemu liabeehi waqawmihi innanee baraon mimma taAAbudoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waith qala ibraheemu liabeehi waqawmihi innanee baraon mimma taAAbudoona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.english: excepting Him who originated me; indeed He will guide me.’
verses.transliteration_html: Illa allathee fataranee fainnahu sayahdeeni
verses.transliteration_text: Illa allathee fataranee fainnahu sayahdeeni

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةًۭ فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.english: He made it a lasting word among his posterity so that they may come back [to the right path].
verses.transliteration_html: WajaAAalaha kalimatan baqiyatan fee AAaqibihi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: WajaAAalaha kalimatan baqiyatan fee AAaqibihi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona

verses.arabic: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.english: Indeed, I provided for these and their fathers until the truth and a manifest apostle came to them.
verses.transliteration_html: Bal mattaAAtu haolai waabaahum hatta jaahumu alhaqqu warasoolun mubeenun
verses.transliteration_text: Bal mattaAAtu haolai waabaahum hatta jaahumu alhaqqu warasoolun mubeenun

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.english: But when the truth came to them, they said, ‘This is magic, and we indeed disbelieve in it.’
verses.transliteration_html: Walamma jaahumu alhaqqu qaloo hatha sihrun wainna bihi kafiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Walamma jaahumu alhaqqu qaloo hatha sihrun wainna bihi kafiroona

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ
verses.english: And they said, ‘Why was not this Quran sent down to some great man from the two cities?’
verses.transliteration_html: Waqaloo lawla nuzzila hatha alquranu AAala rajulin mina alqaryatayni AAatheemun
verses.transliteration_text: Waqaloo lawla nuzzila hatha alquranu AAala rajulin mina alqaryatayni AAatheemun

verses.arabic: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍۢ دَرَجَـٰتٍۢ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًۭا سُخْرِيًّۭا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
verses.english: Is it they who dispense the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have dispensed among them their livelihood in the present life, and raised some of them above others in rank, so that some may take others into service, and your Lord’s mercy is better than what they amass.
verses.transliteration_html: Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamna baynahum maAAeeshatahum fee alhayati alddunya warafaAAna baAAdahum fawqa baAAdin darajatin liyattakhitha baAAduhum baAAdan sukhriyyan warahmatu rabbika khayrun mimma yajmaAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamna baynahum maAAeeshatahum fee alhayati alddunya warafaAAna baAAdahum fawqa baAAdin darajatin liyattakhitha baAAduhum baAAdan sukhriyyan warahmatu rabbika khayrun mimma yajmaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًۭا مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ
verses.english: Were it not [for the danger] that mankind would be one community, We would have made for those who defy the All-beneficent, silver roofs for their houses and [silver] stairways by which they ascend,
verses.transliteration_html: Walawla an yakoona alnnasu ommatan wahidatan lajaAAalna liman yakfuru bialrrahmani libuyootihim suqufan min fiddatin wamaAAarija AAalayha yathharoona
verses.transliteration_text: Walawla an yakoona alnnasu ommatan wahidatan lajaAAalna liman yakfuru bialrrahmani libuyootihim suqufan min fiddatin wamaAAarija AAalayha yathharoona

verses.arabic: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
verses.english: and [silver] doors for their houses and [silver] couches on which they recline,
verses.transliteration_html: Walibuyootihim abwaban wasururan AAalayha yattakioona
verses.transliteration_text: Walibuyootihim abwaban wasururan AAalayha yattakioona

verses.arabic: وَزُخْرُفًۭا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.english: and ornaments of gold; yet all that would be nothing but the wares of the life of this world, and the Hereafter is for the Godwary near your Lord.
verses.transliteration_html: Wazukhrufan wain kullu thalika lamma mataAAu alhayati alddunya waalakhiratu AAinda rabbika lilmuttaqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Wazukhrufan wain kullu thalika lamma mataAAu alhayati alddunya waalakhiratu AAinda rabbika lilmuttaqeena

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَـٰنًۭا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌۭ
verses.english: We assign a devil to be the companion of him who turns a blind eye to the remembrance of the All-beneficent.
verses.transliteration_html: Waman yaAAshu AAan thikri alrrahmani nuqayyid lahu shaytanan fahuwa lahu qareenun
verses.transliteration_text: Waman yaAAshu AAan thikri alrrahmani nuqayyid lahu shaytanan fahuwa lahu qareenun

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verses.english: Indeed they bar them from the way [of Allah], while they suppose that they are [rightly] guided.
verses.transliteration_html: Wainnahum layasuddoonahum AAani alssabeeli wayahsaboona annahum muhtadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wainnahum layasuddoonahum AAani alssabeeli wayahsaboona annahum muhtadoona

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ
verses.english: When he comes to Us, he will say, ‘I wish there had been between me and you the distance between the east and the west! What an evil companion [you are]!’
verses.transliteration_html: Hatta itha jaana qala ya layta baynee wabaynaka buAAda almashriqayni fabisa alqareenu
verses.transliteration_text: Hatta itha jaana qala ya layta baynee wabaynaka buAAda almashriqayni fabisa alqareenu

verses.arabic: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
verses.english: ‘Today that will be of no avail to you. As you did wrong, so will you share in the punishment.’
verses.transliteration_html: Walan yanfaAAakumu alyawma ith thalamtum annakum fee alAAathabi mushtarikoona
verses.transliteration_text: Walan yanfaAAakumu alyawma ith thalamtum annakum fee alAAathabi mushtarikoona

verses.arabic: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.english: Can you, then, make the deaf hear or guide the blind and those who are in manifest error?
verses.transliteration_html: Afaanta tusmiAAu alssumma aw tahdee alAAumya waman kana fee dalalin mubeenin
verses.transliteration_text: Afaanta tusmiAAu alssumma aw tahdee alAAumya waman kana fee dalalin mubeenin

verses.arabic: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
verses.english: We will indeed take vengeance on them, whether We take you away
verses.transliteration_html: Faimma nathhabanna bika fainna minhum muntaqimoona
verses.transliteration_text: Faimma nathhabanna bika fainna minhum muntaqimoona

verses.arabic: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَـٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ
verses.english: or show you what We have promised them, for indeed We hold them in Our power.
verses.transliteration_html: Aw nuriyannaka allathee waAAadnahum fainna AAalayhim muqtadiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Aw nuriyannaka allathee waAAadnahum fainna AAalayhim muqtadiroona

verses.arabic: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
verses.english: So hold fast to what has been revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
verses.transliteration_html: Faistamsik biallathee oohiya ilayka innaka AAala siratin mustaqeemin
verses.transliteration_text: Faistamsik biallathee oohiya ilayka innaka AAala siratin mustaqeemin

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌۭ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
verses.english: Indeed it is a reminder for you and your people, and soon you will be questioned.
verses.transliteration_html: Wainnahu lathikrun laka waliqawmika wasawfa tusaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Wainnahu lathikrun laka waliqawmika wasawfa tusaloona

verses.arabic: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ءَالِهَةًۭ يُعْبَدُونَ
verses.english: Ask those of Our apostles We have sent before you: Did We set up any gods to be worshipped besides the All-beneficent?
verses.transliteration_html: Waisal man arsalna min qablika min rusulina ajaAAalna min dooni alrrahmani alihatan yuAAbadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waisal man arsalna min qablika min rusulina ajaAAalna min dooni alrrahmani alihatan yuAAbadoona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.english: Certainly We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his elite. He said, ‘I am indeed an apostle of the Lord of all the worlds.’
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad arsalna moosa biayatina ila firAAawna wamalaihi faqala innee rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad arsalna moosa biayatina ila firAAawna wamalaihi faqala innee rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.english: But when he brought them Our signs, they indeed laughed at them.
verses.transliteration_html: Falamma jaahum biayatina itha hum minha yadhakoona
verses.transliteration_text: Falamma jaahum biayatina itha hum minha yadhakoona

verses.arabic: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.english: We did not show them a sign but it was greater than the other, and We visited on them punishment so that they might come back.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama nureehim min ayatin illa hiya akbaru min okhtiha waakhathnahum bialAAathabi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wama nureehim min ayatin illa hiya akbaru min okhtiha waakhathnahum bialAAathabi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ
verses.english: They would say, ‘O magician! Invoke your Lord for us by the covenant He has made with you [to remove this scourge]. We will indeed be guided [when it is removed].’
verses.transliteration_html: Waqaloo ya ayyuha alsahiru odAAu lana rabbaka bima AAahida AAindaka innana lamuhtadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waqaloo ya ayyuha alsahiru odAAu lana rabbaka bima AAahida AAindaka innana lamuhtadoona

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
verses.english: But when We lifted the punishment from them, behold, they would break their pledge.
verses.transliteration_html: Falamma kashafna AAanhumu alAAathaba itha hum yankuthoona
verses.transliteration_text: Falamma kashafna AAanhumu alAAathaba itha hum yankuthoona

verses.arabic: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَـٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.english: And Pharaoh proclaimed to his people, saying, ‘O my people! Do not the kingdom of Egypt and these rivers that run at my feet belong to me? Do you not perceive?
verses.transliteration_html: Wanada firAAawnu fee qawmihi qala ya qawmi alaysa lee mulku misra wahathihi alanharu tajree min tahtee afala tubsiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Wanada firAAawnu fee qawmihi qala ya qawmi alaysa lee mulku misra wahathihi alanharu tajree min tahtee afala tubsiroona

verses.arabic: أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌۭ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
verses.english: Am I not better than this wretch who cannot even speak clearly?
verses.transliteration_html: Am ana khayrun min hatha allathee huwa maheenun wala yakadu yubeenu
verses.transliteration_text: Am ana khayrun min hatha allathee huwa maheenun wala yakadu yubeenu

verses.arabic: فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌۭ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ
verses.english: Why no bracelets of gold have been thrown to him, nor any angels accompany him as escorts?’
verses.transliteration_html: Falawla olqiya AAalayhi aswiratun min thahabin aw jaa maAAahu almalaikatu muqtarineena
verses.transliteration_text: Falawla olqiya AAalayhi aswiratun min thahabin aw jaa maAAahu almalaikatu muqtarineena

verses.arabic: فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.english: Thus did he mislead his people and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were a transgressing lot.
verses.transliteration_html: Faistakhaffa qawmahu faataAAoohu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Faistakhaffa qawmahu faataAAoohu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.english: So when they roused Our wrath, We took vengeance on them and drowned them all.
verses.transliteration_html: Falamma asafoona intaqamna minhum faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena
verses.transliteration_text: Falamma asafoona intaqamna minhum faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ سَلَفًۭا وَمَثَلًۭا لِّلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.english: Thus We made them the vanguard and an example for posterity.
verses.transliteration_html: FajaAAalnahum salafan wamathalan lilakhireena
verses.transliteration_text: FajaAAalnahum salafan wamathalan lilakhireena

verses.arabic: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
verses.english: When the Son of Mary was cited as an example, behold, your people raise an outcry.
verses.transliteration_html: Walamma duriba ibnu maryama mathalan itha qawmuka minhu yasiddoona
verses.transliteration_text: Walamma duriba ibnu maryama mathalan itha qawmuka minhu yasiddoona

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَـٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
verses.english: They say, ‘Are our gods better or he?’ They cite him to you only for the sake of contention. Indeed, they are a contentious lot.
verses.transliteration_html: Waqaloo aalihatuna khayrun am huwa ma daraboohu laka illa jadalan bal hum qawmun khasimoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waqaloo aalihatuna khayrun am huwa ma daraboohu laka illa jadalan bal hum qawmun khasimoona

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.english: He was just a servant whom We had blessed and made an exemplar for the Children of Israel.
verses.transliteration_html: In huwa illa AAabdun anAAamna AAalayhi wajaAAalnahu mathalan libanee israeela
verses.transliteration_text: In huwa illa AAabdun anAAamna AAalayhi wajaAAalnahu mathalan libanee israeela

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَـٰٓئِكَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
verses.english: Had We wished We would have set angels in your stead to be [your] successors on the earth.
verses.transliteration_html: Walaw nashao lajaAAalna minkum malaikatan fee alardi yakhlufoona
verses.transliteration_text: Walaw nashao lajaAAalna minkum malaikatan fee alardi yakhlufoona

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌۭ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
verses.english: [Say,] ‘Indeed he is a portent of the Hour; so do not doubt it and follow me. This is a straight path.
verses.transliteration_html: Wainnahu laAAilmun lilssaAAati fala tamtarunna biha waittabiAAooni hatha siratun mustaqeemun
verses.transliteration_text: Wainnahu laAAilmun lilssaAAati fala tamtarunna biha waittabiAAooni hatha siratun mustaqeemun

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.english: Do not let Satan bar you [from the way of Allah]. Indeed he is your manifest enemy.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wala yasuddannakumu alshshaytanu innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun
verses.transliteration_text: Wala yasuddannakumu alshshaytanu innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.english: When Jesus brought those manifest proofs, he said, ‘I have certainly brought you wisdom, and [I have come] to make clear to you some of the things that you differ about. So be wary of Allah and obey me.
verses.transliteration_html: Walamma jaa AAeesa bialbayyinati qala qad jitukum bialhikmati waliobayyina lakum baAAda allathee takhtalifoona feehi faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni
verses.transliteration_text: Walamma jaa AAeesa bialbayyinati qala qad jitukum bialhikmati waliobayyina lakum baAAda allathee takhtalifoona feehi faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
verses.english: Indeed Allah is my Lord and your Lord; so worship Him. This is a straight path.’
verses.transliteration_html: Inna Allaha huwa rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun
verses.transliteration_text: Inna Allaha huwa rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun

verses.arabic: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.english: But the factions differed among themselves. So woe to the wrongdoers for the punishment of a painful day.
verses.transliteration_html: Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena thalamoo min AAathabi yawmin aleemin
verses.transliteration_text: Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena thalamoo min AAathabi yawmin aleemin

verses.arabic: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.english: Do they not consider that the Hour may overtake them suddenly while they are unaware?
verses.transliteration_html: Hal yanthuroona illa alssaAAata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona
verses.transliteration_text: Hal yanthuroona illa alssaAAata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona

verses.arabic: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.english: On that day, friends will be one another’s enemies, except for the Godwary.
verses.transliteration_html: Alakhillao yawmaithin baAAduhum libaAAdin AAaduwwun illa almuttaqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Alakhillao yawmaithin baAAduhum libaAAdin AAaduwwun illa almuttaqeena

verses.arabic: يَـٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
verses.english: [They will be told,] ‘O My servants! Today you will have no fear, nor will you grieve
verses.transliteration_html: Ya AAibadi la khawfun AAalaykumu alyawma wala antum tahzanoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ya AAibadi la khawfun AAalaykumu alyawma wala antum tahzanoona

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.english: —those who believed in Our signs and had been Muslims.
verses.transliteration_html: Allatheena amanoo biayatina wakanoo muslimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Allatheena amanoo biayatina wakanoo muslimeena

verses.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
verses.english: Enter paradise, you and your spouses, rejoicing.’
verses.transliteration_html: Odkhuloo aljannata antum waazwajukum tuhbaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Odkhuloo aljannata antum waazwajukum tuhbaroona

verses.arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍۢ مِّن ذَهَبٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.english: They will be served around with golden dishes and goblets, and therein will be whatever the souls desire and eyes delight in. ‘You will remain in it [forever].
verses.transliteration_html: Yutafu AAalayhim bisihafin min thahabin waakwabin wafeeha ma tashtaheehi alanfusu watalaththu alaAAyunu waantum feeha khalidoona
verses.transliteration_text: Yutafu AAalayhim bisihafin min thahabin waakwabin wafeeha ma tashtaheehi alanfusu watalaththu alaAAyunu waantum feeha khalidoona

verses.arabic: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.english: That is the paradise you have been given to inherit for what you used to do.
verses.transliteration_html: Watilka aljannatu allatee oorithtumooha bima kuntum taAAmaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Watilka aljannatu allatee oorithtumooha bima kuntum taAAmaloona

verses.arabic: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌۭ كَثِيرَةٌۭ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.english: There are abundant fruits for you in it, from which you will eat.’
verses.transliteration_html: Lakum feeha fakihatun katheeratun minha takuloona
verses.transliteration_text: Lakum feeha fakihatun katheeratun minha takuloona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.english: Indeed the guilty will remain [forever] in the punishment of hell.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna almujrimeena fee AAathabi jahannama khalidoona
verses.transliteration_text: Inna almujrimeena fee AAathabi jahannama khalidoona

verses.arabic: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
verses.english: It will not be lightened for them, and they will be despondent in it.
verses.transliteration_html: La yufattaru AAanhum wahum feehi mublisoona
verses.transliteration_text: La yufattaru AAanhum wahum feehi mublisoona

verses.arabic: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.english: We did not wrong them, but they themselves were wrongdoers.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama thalamnahum walakin kanoo humu alththalimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Wama thalamnahum walakin kanoo humu alththalimeena

verses.arabic: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
verses.english: They will call out, ‘O Malik! Let your Lord finish us off!’ He will say, ‘Indeed you will stay on.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wanadaw ya maliku liyaqdi AAalayna rabbuka qala innakum makithoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wanadaw ya maliku liyaqdi AAalayna rabbuka qala innakum makithoona

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ جِئْنَـٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ
verses.english: ‘We certainly brought you the truth, but most of you were averse to the truth.’
verses.transliteration_html: Laqad jinakum bialhaqqi walakinna aktharakum lilhaqqi karihoona
verses.transliteration_text: Laqad jinakum bialhaqqi walakinna aktharakum lilhaqqi karihoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ
verses.english: Have they settled on some [devious] plan? Indeed, We too are settling [on Our plans].
verses.transliteration_html: Am abramoo amran fainna mubrimoona
verses.transliteration_text: Am abramoo amran fainna mubrimoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.english: Do they suppose that We do not hear their secret thoughts and their secret talks? Yes indeed [We do]! And with them are Our messengers, writing down [everything].
verses.transliteration_html: Am yahsaboona anna la nasmaAAu sirrahum wanajwahum bala warusuluna ladayhim yaktuboona
verses.transliteration_text: Am yahsaboona anna la nasmaAAu sirrahum wanajwahum bala warusuluna ladayhim yaktuboona

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدٌۭ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَـٰبِدِينَ
verses.english: Say, ‘If the All-beneficent had offspring, I would have been the first to worship [him].’
verses.transliteration_html: Qul in kana lilrrahmani waladun faana awwalu alAAabideena
verses.transliteration_text: Qul in kana lilrrahmani waladun faana awwalu alAAabideena

verses.arabic: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.english: Clear is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, of whatever they allege [concerning Him]!
verses.transliteration_html: Subhana rabbi alssamawati waalardi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona
verses.transliteration_text: Subhana rabbi alssamawati waalardi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.english: So leave them to gossip and play until they encounter the day they are promised.
verses.transliteration_html: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَـٰهٌۭ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَـٰهٌۭ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.english: It is He who is God in the sky, and God on the earth, and He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.
verses.transliteration_html: Wahuwa allathee fee alssamai ilahun wafee alardi ilahun wahuwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu
verses.transliteration_text: Wahuwa allathee fee alssamai ilahun wafee alardi ilahun wahuwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu

verses.arabic: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.english: Blessed is He to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and with Him is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Him you will be brought back.
verses.transliteration_html: Watabaraka allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma waAAindahu AAilmu alssaAAati wailayhi turjaAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Watabaraka allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma waAAindahu AAilmu alssaAAati wailayhi turjaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.english: Those whom they invoke besides Him have no power of intercession, except those who are witness to the truth and who know [for whom to intercede].
verses.transliteration_html: Wala yamliku allatheena yadAAoona min doonihi alshshafaAAata illa man shahida bialhaqqi wahum yaAAlamoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wala yamliku allatheena yadAAoona min doonihi alshshafaAAata illa man shahida bialhaqqi wahum yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.english: If you ask them, ‘Who created them?’ they will surely say, ‘Allah.’ Then where do they stray?
verses.transliteration_html: Walain saaltahum man khalaqahum layaqoolunna Allahu faanna yufakoona
verses.transliteration_text: Walain saaltahum man khalaqahum layaqoolunna Allahu faanna yufakoona

verses.arabic: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.english: And his plaint: ‘My Lord! Indeed these are a people who will not have faith!’
verses.transliteration_html: Waqeelihi yarabbi inna haolai qawmun la yuminoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waqeelihi yarabbi inna haolai qawmun la yuminoona

verses.arabic: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَـٰمٌۭ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.english: So disregard them, and say, ‘Peace!’ Soon they will know.
verses.transliteration_html: Faisfah AAanhum waqul salamun fasawfa yaAAlamoona
verses.transliteration_text: Faisfah AAanhum waqul salamun fasawfa yaAAlamoona
